parameters.query:
-- Every morning at 5.00. The computer n8n runs on may be asleep then, so
-- the trigger fires every hour, and this lets a run through only when the
-- latest 5.00 has passed since the menus were last set: bot_commands_set_at,
-- which "Bot users" sets on every run, Run now's too. Otherwise nothing
-- comes out and the run ends here.
WITH here AS (
    SELECT now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS now
),
slot AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN planned <= now THEN planned ELSE planned - interval '1 day' END AS at
      FROM (SELECT now, date_trunc('day', now) + time '05:00' AS planned FROM here) x
),
last_run AS (
    SELECT (SELECT nullif(value, '')::timestamptz FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'bot_commands_set_at') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS at
)
SELECT to_char(slot.at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due_since
  FROM slot, last_run
 WHERE coalesce(last_run.at, '-infinity') < slot.at;

-- Everyone who has used the bot, and whether they are an admin now. A
-- removed admin counts as not one, so their chat goes back to the list
-- everyone sees. It also notes when the menus were set, for "Due".
WITH noted AS (
    INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value, description)
    VALUES ('bot_commands_set_at', now()::text,
            'When the bot''s command menus were last set: every morning, or Run now. Set by n8n')
    ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()
)
SELECT telegram_user_id, (role = 'admin' AND removed_at IS NULL) AS admin
  FROM users
 WHERE telegram_user_id IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY id;
